event_chain.summary: Stolen credentials used on internal analytics tool

summary: An unauthorized party used stolen credentials to gain read-only access to an internal analytics system of Ultrahuman, the Indian maker of smart rings, exposing customer contact details, account information, order and transaction history and fitness/wellness product usage data. Passwords and payment data were not affected. The company says about 0.1% of users (roughly 1,000 people) may be affected; its California notice gives the breach date as March 27, 2026.
